249.en: I made an appointment with my girlfriend to watch a movie together.

253.en: She introduced her boyfriend to me; they look like a perfect match.
She is preparing to marry her boyfriend.

256.en: I had dinner at a restaurant the day before yesterday evening.

257.en: If you are sick, you should drink more water and rest more.

257.en: He didn't come to the office yesterday; he said he was sick.

258.en: This piece of bread smells good.

258.en: He bought some freshly baked bread at the bakery.

259.en: The hospital entrance was crowded with patients.
He goes to the hospital for medical treatment at set dates.

260.en: Since you have already tried your best, it doesn't matter what the result is.

261.en: Can you go there to buy fruit?

262.en: Rows of chairs are arranged neatly in the conference room.

262.en: Children, please sit on the chairs.

He cooks as soon as he gets home.

264.en: The cooking technique for these special pot-stickers is extremely complex.

264.zh: 这家的饺子味道非常鲜美。
264.en: The taste of the pot-stickers at this restaurant is very fresh and delicious.

265.en: Primary school students need to develop good habits.

265.en: In the professional field, he acts like a beginner.

266.en: In order to buy that book, he lined up at the bookstore entrance for a long time.
The door of this bookstore is very wide.

267.en: This middle school student is very interested in studying.

267.en: Schools should not only impart knowledge but also guide high school students to establish a correct outlook on life.

268.en: Please try your best to complete this task before lunch time.

268.en: Although the meeting has been postponed, we still decided to take care of lunch first.

There is still a little water in the cup.
There are two cups in the car.

270.en: Before officially being dismissed, please remain quiet.

270.en: The principal announced the end of the meeting and signaled that everyone was dismissed.

271.en: The lights in the cinema gradually dimmed, and the movie was about to start.

271.en: The seat position in the cinema is not bad.

272.zh: 早饭我通常会买两个包子和一杯豆浆。
272.en: I usually buy two steamed buns and a cup of soy milk for breakfast.

272.en: Although he is a skillful chef, he is completely ignorant when it comes to making steamed buns.

273.en: Because I didn't have enough time, I went to school without eating breakfast.

273.zh: 虽然他工作很忙，但他每天都会坚持吃早饭。
273.en: Although he is very busy with work, he insists on eating breakfast every day.

273.zh: 如果经常不吃早饭，很容易患病。
273.en: If you don't eat breakfast often, it is easy to fall ill.

274.zh: 请你们一起读这些汉字。
274.en: Please read these Chinese characters together.
I like to read Chinese characters.

275.zh: 星期天我们一起去吃中国菜吧。
275.en: Let's go eat Chinese food together this Sunday.

275.zh: 这周星期天，我们将举办一场关于环境保护的讲座。
275.en: This Sunday, we will hold a lecture about environmental protection.

275.zh: 每个星期天，他都去教堂。
275.en: He goes to church every Sunday.

276.en: This question is a bit complicated.

277.en: There is a bowl of rice on the table.

277.zh: 为了健康，他每顿饭只吃半碗米饭。
277.en: For the sake of his health, he only eats half a bowl of rice per meal.
This is the rice I eat day-to-day.

278.zh: 下午我只吃了一点儿快餐。
278.en: I only had a small snack in the afternoon.

278.zh: 房间里很温暖，一点儿也不冷。
278.en: It is warm inside the room, not cold at all.

279.en: Do you have time on Sunday?

279.zh: 由于星期日有重要会议，经理不得不加班。
279.en: Because there is an important meeting on Sunday, the manager has to work overtime.

279.zh: 尽管已经临近截止日期，他依然在星期日选择休息，以保持充沛的精力。
279.en: Despite the approaching deadline, he still chose to rest on Sunday to maintain his energy.

280.en: It is cold now and then outside.

280.zh: 尽管外边很冷，他还是出门了。
280.en: Although it is cold outside, he went out anyway.

281.en: No need to thank me, don't mention it.

281.zh: 他在外交场合显得有些不客气。
281.en: He appeared somewhat impolite in the diplomatic setting.

282.zh: 北京有很多好玩儿的地方。
虽然这里的风景很普通，但是有一些好玩儿的活动。
282.en: Although the scenery here is ordinary, there are some fun activities.

282.zh: 与其在家里看电视，不如去公园找些好玩儿的事儿做。
282.en: Rather than watching TV at home, it's better to go to the park and find something fun to do.

283.zh: 图书馆明天早上八点开门。
283.en: The library opens at eight o'clock tomorrow morning.
I go to class at eight.

284.en: How much is one hundred and five?
He ran no more than 500 meters.
This piece of clothing is worth 100 yuan.

285.zh: 我家附近有一个大超市。
285.en: There is a big supermarket near my house.

285.zh: 请往西南走，你会看到一家超市。
285.en: Please walk towards the southwest, and you will see a supermarket.

285.zh: 我用银行卡在超市买东西。
285.en: I use my bank card to buy things at the supermarket.

286.en: Put a dot on the paper.

286.zh: 图书馆明天早上八点开门。
286.en: The library opens at eight o'clock tomorrow morning.

286.zh: 我差点忘记了你的生日。

287.en: There are too many cats here.

287.zh: 北京有很多好玩儿的地方。

287.en: You should take more breaks during your study.

288.en: I am twenty years old this year.

289.en: The meeting will start at nine-thirty.

289.zh: 公元二零一九年很有意思。
289.en: The year 2019 AD was very interesting.
The engineering project will be finished in September.

290.en: How much is one hundred and five?

290.zh: 公元二零一九年很有意思。
290.en: The year 2019 AD was very interesting.

290.zh: 在这个数学集合中没有零。
290.en: There is no zero in this mathematical set.

291.en: We have a holiday on Saturday.
I go home at six o'clock.

292.zh: 午饭我打算去餐厅吃一碗热乎的面条儿。
292.en: I plan to go to the cafeteria for a bowl of hot noodles for lunch.

292.zh: 虽然这种面条儿的制作工艺比较复杂，但味道非常地道。
292.en: Although the production process for this type of noodle is quite complex, the taste is very authentic.

292.zh: 这家老字号餐厅坚持采用传统手工拉制面条儿，因此口感极其筋道。
292.en: This long-established restaurant insists on using traditional handmade techniques for their noodles, resulting in an extremely chewy texture.

293.en: There are 7 tables in the classroom.

293.en: Please set the alarm clock for 7 o'clock tomorrow morning.

294.en: There are three thousand students in the school.

294.zh: 这次旅行我们一共花了五千块。
294.en: We spent five thousand yuan in total on this trip.

294.zh: 这次旅行的费用在三千块以内。
294.en: The cost of this trip is less than 3,000 yuan.

295.en: I lived in Beijing for three years.
My older sister is three years older than me.

297.en: I am using my cell phone to watch a movie.
The mobile phone signal is not good.

298.en: The World Cup is held once every four years.

299.en: The meeting will start in 5 minutes.
How much is one hundred and five?
He is five years old this year.

300.en: Please give me a glass of water.

300.zh: 他介绍了一本好书给我。
300.en: He presented a good book to me.
He is too tired and wants to take a rest.
